title: Reassessment Calendar for Assisted Living Residents
content:
Reassessments under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement follow a fixed schedule and are recorded by assessment type: pre-admission, post-move-in, routine, change-of-condition or post-hospital.

| Assessment type | When it is due or permitted |
|---|---|
| Post-move-in | Completed no later than the post-move-in reassessment period (30 calendar days) after the move-in date. |
| Routine | Due once the days since the last assessment reach the routine reassessment interval of the care level billed, and completed no later than that day. The days since the last assessment are the handling date less the date of the most recent assessment of any type on the residency, in calendar days. |
| Post-hospital | Required after every return from an absence whose reason is hospital and whose midnights away are at least the hospital-stay trigger (2 midnights). The midnights away are the return date less the absence start date, in calendar days. Completed no later than the post-hospital reassessment period (3 calendar days) after the resident returns from the hospital stay. |
| Change-of-condition | May be performed at any time on a nurse's referral or at the written request of the resident or their representative; a family request is recorded as such but never sets the score. |

**Time rule for the post-hospital reassessment.** The post-hospital period is counted in calendar days from the absence return date recorded on the residency, the return date being day 0, and a reassessment completed on the last day is on time.

**One per type per date.** Only one assessment of a given type is recorded per residency per date.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Hospital absence from 3 June to 10 June: 7 midnights away, at least 2, so a post-hospital reassessment is required. Return date 10 June is day 0; a reassessment completed on 13 June (day 3) is on time; one completed on 14 June (day 4) is not.
- Hospital absence from 3 June to 4 June: 1 midnight away, fewer than 2, so this rule requires no post-hospital reassessment.
- A family visit of 12 midnights is not a hospital absence and requires no post-hospital reassessment.
- Routine interval at Assisted Living Care Level 5 of 90 days: a last assessment on 1 March makes the routine reassessment due on 30 May (90 days later), to be completed no later than that day.
